messages:
maya: Heads up — safety scan flagged CVE-2024-22042 in starlette 0.23.1 (pulled in via fastapi). Failing our vuln workflow. Repro in CI attached.

lucas: Is there an upstream patch? can we bump to 0.23.2 quickly? last time we bumped it broke macOS wheels in CI.

maya: Upstream released 0.23.2 with the fix but maintainers only published sdist for some tags; wheel availability varies by platform. That explains the macOS break.

anya: Thoughts: quick mitigation = add a pip constraint pin for Hosted and Dedicated bootstrap images so runtime uses patched version. Longer term = regenerate poetry.lock and run full test matrix.

lucas: +1 on two-step. Quick constraint prevents exploit window without immediate lock churn. But note: our poetry CI job will fail if we change constraints without lock regen. We should gate the lock regen behind a CI patch branch.

ci-bot: Build matrix snippet (failing lines):
```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for starlette, which is required to install pyproject-based projects
ERROR: wheel: invalid wheel file record: Hash mismatch for METADATA
```
macos-latest / py310 / manylinux wheels mismatch.

maya: Proposal: 1) Open hotfix PR adding constraints.txt with `starlette>=0.23.2,<0.24` and update our bootstrap Dockerfiles to use `pip --constraint constraints.txt` during install. 2) Run a non-blocking poetry.lock regen branch and split out regen into staged rollouts. 3) Add CI gating: run quick vuln smoke tests before rollout.

anya: I'll draft the PR for the constraints + docker tweak. Also I'll add a remediation entry in the security tracker and tag it for "hotfix". No KMS or audit log changes expected — this is a runtime lib update only.

security-oncall: Please include the vuln advisory link and affected product matrix in the tracker. Confirm whether Dedicated private images need a backport.

lucas: For Dedicated we should backport the constraints into the base image (ami/container) so customers who pin images get the fix without waiting for lock regen. Anya can craft backport PRs to the image repo.

maya: Ownership: anya + lucas for PRs, maya to coordinate canary on Hosted once PR merges. Timeline: hotfix PR today, QA tomorrow, canary Friday if green.

ci-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 (constraints + docker tweak).

maya: Thanks. tagging @devops for image backport and @platform for canary orchestration. :white_check_mark:

anya: Will also run a quick dependency diff and paste results here after regen branch is ready.

lucas: Also add a CI exception document so engineers know how to proceed if lock regen causes transient failures. Keep escalation path to security-oncall.

maya: ok locking this thread into action items. I'll follow up with canary checklist and postmortem template in the tracker. :memo:

ci-bot: Security tracker entry: https://internal.redwood/sec/issue/CV-2024-22042-1
